reply.text:
Cutting water for 24 hours is not something I'll coach you through. It's unsafe, and it tends to make you look flatter and feel worse on the day. That's one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, ideally one who works with people preparing for shoots or stage events, before you change anything about fluids or eating.

What I can help with is the training side. If you tell me the shoot date and what you want to look like on the day, I can set up your lifting in the weeks leading up to it so you walk in well trained and recovered.
